purpose: Official dense WA-JEPA evaluation and untrained sparse-interface sensitivity; no training
source_selection_reason: Official parent preset has 12 inference steps, matching public state.pt and paper Appendix C; latest commit changes only sampling steps to 4. Selected before any inference scores, not a sweep.
seed_scope: Official generator resets at each predict_trajectory call; same initial scene and ego noise across scenes. One preset seed, not the paper's 10-seed mean.
precision: Official YAML requests bfloat16, but unmodified NAVSIM agent constructs float32 parameters and has no autocast. Preserve actual original float32/TF32 execution.
smoke_scene_selection: Lexicographically first token from each of the first six lexicographically ordered official navtest logs, fixed in preflight before GPU inference

parallel_evaluation.policy: User permits45GB per GPU. Seven workers each predicts~40GB NVML incl context overhead; eighth risks exceeding conservative decimal45GB. Disjoint sorted-token modulo14; reuse earlier completed scene records. GPU1 full only after isolated sparse timing. Worker count is not a linear throughput guarantee.

resource_plan_revision_before_full: Six-scene official FP32 smoke measured 25.4499 single-GPU hours, exceeding provisional 24h. Before full launch, register 30GPU-h/18h dual-GPU wall cap using authorized, now-free GPUs0/1. No model/scoring changes or score-based tuning.

all_id_tolerance.reason: Canonical all-ID packing preserves ordering, tensor shape, parameters, dtype and kernels; bitwise equality required, including same-run dense repeat. Any non-determinism or divergence must be investigated, not hidden by relaxing tolerance.

sparse_benchmark.interpretation: Untrained distribution-shift sensitivity only, not learned selection performance or hypothesis rejection
